patterns.title: Feature-based folder structure over type-based
patterns.problem: Grouping files by type (components/, hooks/, types/) scatters related code across many directories as features grow.
patterns.solution: Co-locate domain code inside feature folders (features/auth, features/payments) with a barrel index.ts; keep shared cross-cutting code (ui/, lib/) at top level. See bulletproof-react and matthewswong.com real-world structure.
patterns.anti_pattern: Flat type-based folders that force context-switching between six dirs for one feature.

patterns.title: Separate server state from client state
patterns.problem: Mixing remote/cacheable data with local UI state in one store causes stale-data bugs and broken back/forward behavior.
patterns.solution: Server state (cache, not state) via TanStack Query/SWR/Apollo; URL state via router params; client UI state via Zustand/Jotai/Context; form state via React Hook Form. Source: youngju.dev state-management guide and r/reactjs 2026 thread.
patterns.anti_pattern: Putting API-fetched data into Redux/global store and re-fetching manually.

patterns.title: React Server Components + Server Actions for data-heavy UI
patterns.problem: Client-side data fetching ships large bundles and creates request waterfalls.
patterns.solution: Use RSC (run only on server, zero client JS) and 'use server' Actions for mutations; pair with useActionState/useOptimistic. Source: react.dev/reference and Next.js docs.
patterns.anti_pattern: Fetching everything in useEffect on the client when the data lives server-side.

patterns.title: Monorepo with pnpm workspaces + Turborepo
patterns.problem: Version drift and duplicated tooling across multiple apps/packages.
patterns.solution: pnpm workspaces + turbo.json task graph (dependsOn ^build, outputs, remote cache). Extract shared code to internal packages only when a real sharing need exists. Source: vercel/turborepo best-practices.
patterns.anti_pattern: Splitting into many microrepos prematurely, or nested wildcards like packages/**.

patterns.title: Strict TypeScript + type-aware linting
patterns.problem: Untyped or loosely-typed code ships runtime bugs that the compiler could catch.
patterns.solution: Enable strict mode in tsconfig and apply typescript-eslint recommended + recommended-requiring-type-checking; Biome 2.x adds type-aware rules. Source: r/typescript good-practices thread.
patterns.anti_pattern: Pervasive `any` and disabled strict flags to silence errors.

patterns.title: Compile-time reactivity with Svelte runes
patterns.problem: Runtime reactivity systems add overhead and implicit mental models.
patterns.solution: Svelte 5 runes: $state for mutable reactive values, $derived for computed, $effect for side effects. Source: svelte.dev/docs.
patterns.anti_pattern: Manual subscribe/unsubscribe or re-implementing reactivity with hooks.

patterns.title: Push logic to the edge boundary
patterns.problem: Centralized servers add latency for global users.
patterns.solution: Deploy edge functions / middleware (Deno Deploy, Bun, Next.js edge, Cloudflare) for low-latency, geographically-close compute; keep heavy work in origin services.
patterns.anti_pattern: A single heavy monolith handling all traffic regardless of user location.

patterns.title: End-to-end type safety with Zod + tRPC
patterns.problem: API contracts drift between client and server, producing runtime mismatches.
patterns.solution: Define schemas once with Zod; derive types and expose procedures via tRPC so the client call is fully typed. Source: t3-oss/create-t3-app (T3 Stack).
patterns.anti_pattern: Hand-written fetch clients and duplicated, drift-prone DTO types per side.

methodologies.name: Bulletproof React architecture
methodologies.summary: Opinionated, scalable structure for production React apps with clean boundaries and consistent conventions.
methodologies.steps:
Start from Vite React TS scaffold
Group code by feature with barrel index.ts
Build a thin API layer (services/) separate from UI
Manage state by category (server vs client vs form)
Add Vitest + Testing Library and error/security boundaries
Apply strict TS and ESLint/Biome (see github.com/alan2207/bulletproof-react)

methodologies.name: T3 Stack (typesafe full-stack)
methodologies.summary: Modular, full-stack typesafe stack: Next.js + TypeScript + tRPC + Prisma/Drizzle + NextAuth + Tailwind.
methodologies.steps:
Scaffold with create-t3-app
Define DB schema (Prisma/Drizzle)
Expose procedures via tRPC routers
Derive client types end-to-end (no hand-written DTOs)
Add Zod validation at boundaries
Bleed responsibly: keep risky tech in low-risk places

methodologies.name: Turborepo monorepo
methodologies.summary: Fast JS/TS monorepo via pnpm workspaces and content-hash cached task orchestration.
methodologies.steps:
pnpm-workspace.yaml with apps/* and packages/*
Root scripts delegate to 'turbo run <task>'
Define turbo.json tasks (dependsOn ^build, outputs)
Add shared @repo/* config packages (tsconfig, eslint)
Enable remote cache for CI/team
Use --filter to target packages

methodologies.name: Strict TypeScript project setup
methodologies.summary: Maximize compile-time safety and editor assistance from day one.
methodologies.steps:
Set strict: true in tsconfig
Enable noUncheckedIndexedAccess and verbatimModuleSyntax
Apply typescript-eslint recommended + type-checking rules
Add Biome for format+lint in one pass
Use Zod for runtime validation at boundaries

methodologies.name: Biome-only lint + format pipeline
methodologies.summary: Replace ESLint + Prettier with a single Rust binary and one config file.
methodologies.steps:
Install @biomejs/biome
Author biome.json (formatter + linter + assists)
Run 'biome check' and 'biome check --write'
Migrate existing ESLint via 'biome migrate eslint'
Wire into pre-commit and CI

methodologies.name: Feature-first testing with Vitest
methodologies.summary: Test against the same Vite module graph the app uses, no second toolchain.
methodologies.steps:
Install vitest (matches vite version)
Add test block to vite.config.ts (environment jsdom)
Co-locate *.test.ts beside feature code
Use @testing-library/react for components
Generate v8 coverage; run in CI
